attacks.name: Bite
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

superPowers.name: DROP IT!
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 3 or less within |!range| 2 and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Inter-Dimensional Bloodhound
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character. Allied characters roll 1 additional attack die when targeting the chosen character with attacks |<inter_dimensional_bloodhound>this Round|.

superPowers.name: Teleport
superPowers.body: |*Action|: Choose this character or another allied character within |!range| 3 of it and Place it within |!range| 3 of its current position. A character can be Placed by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Inhuman
superPowers.body: This character may reroll 1 die in its attack or defense rolls.

superPowers.name: Who‘s a Good Boy?
superPowers.body: At the start of each of this character's Activations, if there is another allied character within |!range| 2 of it, this character gains 3 |!power|.
